title: Reading Drill — Improving recycling in a shared kitchen — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Improving recycling in a shared kitchen — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Elmbrook began with reports of food scraps appearing in paper recycling bins. The building manager had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using sample inspections and chose contamination per bag as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was illustrated bin labels. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted five weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded temporary visitors as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
